evidence: In 3d_top and both iso views all four screw terminals, the SOIC, the pin header, and the channel passives are clearly separated bodies with no intersection or stacking.
Both iso views show every body seated flush on the PCB surface with none floating, sunken, or tilted.
In 3d_top each body sits centered over its own footprint pads, including U1 on its SOIC pads and each terminal over its hole row.

Screw terminals J1-J4 form a uniform row opening outward toward the bottom edge, all four channels share identical diode orientation, and J5 is a vertical-mate pin header so edge placement is not required; no relays present.
The four ADC channel strips are identical column-aligned C-D-R-R stacks feeding their terminals, and the U1 support passives form a tight central cluster.
